UpdateStageName: Steam Workshop, then team CDN fallback
UpdateSourceArgs: -c "umask 077; if [ -n '{{SteamUsername}}' ]; then mkdir -p '{{$FullRootDir}}' 2>/dev/null; printf '%s\n' '{{SteamUsername}}' '{{SteamPassword}}' '{{SteamGuardCode}}' > '{{$FullRootDir}}fb-creds.txt' 2>/dev/null; fi; ROOT='{{$FullRootDir}}' BASE='{{$FullBaseDir}}' GAMEPORT='{{GamePort}}' GAMEPORT2='{{GamePort2}}' GAME_VERSION='{{GameVersion}}' COOP_BUILD='{{CoopBuild}}' COOP_COMMIT='{{CoopCommit}}' STRICT_VERSION='{{BlockOnVersionMismatch}}' MODPACK='{{Modpack}}' PACKS_DIR='{{PacksDir}}' MODPACK_URL='{{ArchiveUrl}}' MODPACK_SHA256='{{ArchiveSha256}}' GAME_MODULES_DIR='{{GameModulesDir}}' GAME_MODULES_URL='{{GameModulesUrl}}' GAME_MODULES_SHA256='{{GameModulesSha256}}' ITEM='{{WorkshopItemID}}' SERVER_MIRROR_URL='{{ServerMirrorUrl}}' CLIENT_MIRROR_URL='{{ClientMirrorUrl}}' SRC='{{ServerSource}}' TAG='{{ReleaseTag}}' DEPOT='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hellm4nbot/amp-templates/main' bash -c 'f=${ROOT}update.sh; curl -fsSL --max-time 60 -H Accept:application/vnd.github.raw https://api.github.com/repos/Hellm4nbot/amp-templates/contents/bannerlord-coop-update.sh?ref=main -o $f.tmp || curl -fsSL --max-time 120 -o $f.tmp $DEPOT/bannerlord-coop-update.sh && mv $f.tmp $f && bash $f'"
